recommendations.title: Support Ticket Transparency & SLA Enforcement
recommendations.problem: 38 reviews with a low 1.61 rating; users cite 'useless' teams and lack of help for technical difficulties, leading to 7 churn mentions.
recommendations.proposal: Deploy a real-time ticket tracking system with guaranteed 24-hour SLA and an escalation path for technical issues.
recommendations.metric: Improvement in average theme rating from 1.61 to 3.5+ and reduced 'no response' complaints.

recommendations.title: App Stability & Offline Content Reliability
recommendations.problem: 48 reviews with a 2.25 rating; critical issues include vanishing downloaded content and technical errors after updates.
recommendations.proposal: Launch a stability sprint focused on fixing the download manager and resolving UI glitches that hide active classes.
recommendations.metric: Crash-free session rate and reduction in 'app glitches' mentions.

recommendations.title: Course Discovery & Content Organization
recommendations.problem: 38 reviews with 68% negative share; students struggle to find past lectures and report disoriented video documentation.

recommendations.metric: Increase in 'Search to Play' conversion rate and reduction in 'hard to use' feedback.
